title: Exact genera and minimal maps by SAT
claim: Exact orientable genera by SAT (rotation systems with face labels; a bound is excluded by unsatisfiability). (1) Every three-fold space up to 22 points (the 8 untwisted classes) and every twisted one (24 classes): the incidence graph's genus equals the sum of its braces' genera, which is the number of Heawood braces except for one twisted 22-point class whose glue is the trisum of three cubes (genus 3 = 2 atoms + 1); all untwisted ones have genus equal to their number of Heawood braces. (2) Larger spaces: Fano compositions of 4 and 5 planes (genus 4, 5), cycles of 5 and 7 Fano blocks (5, 7), the twisted cube (6), the hexagonal prism and the truncated octahedron as glue (6 and 12; the latter has 180 vertices), and the 35-point space whose glue is the trisum of three cubes (5 = 4 atoms + 1). (3) Minimal maps: the spaces with 7, 13 and 19 points have exactly 16, 128 and 1024 minimum-genus rotation systems, as ticket A's formula predicts, every one a standard connected sum at every tight cut; up to automorphisms and mirroring there are 1, 2 and (for the four 19-point classes) 4, 3, 6 and 4 of them. (4) Additivity beyond the Heawood graph: the trisum of three cubes and the Petersen graph keep their genus when a vertex is deleted and splice additively, while K3,3 does not and K3,3 spliced with K3,3 has genus 1; one rigid side suffices (K3,3 with Petersen has genus 2).
failure_conditions: A space in the stated lists whose genus differs from the sum of its braces' genera, or an untwisted one whose genus differs from its number of Heawood braces.
A count of minimum-genus rotation systems different from ticket A's formula, or a minimum-genus system that is not a standard connected sum at some tight cut.
A splice with a rigid side that is not additive, or a SAT answer that does not reproduce.
foundation_claim_scope: Orientable genus of incidence graphs of three-fold spaces: all classes up to 22 points and the listed larger spaces; minimum-genus rotation systems of the spaces up to 19 points. Counts at 21 and 22 points are ticket A's predictions, not enumerated.

validation.status: checked: 32 classes up to 22 points and 9 larger spaces by exact SAT genus; all minimum-genus rotation systems of 6 spaces enumerated and classified; additivity tests; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.novelty: computational confirmation of ticket A; the SAT model with face labels follows the published approach of Beyer, Chimani, Hedtke and Kotrbcik (minimum genus by SAT/ILP) in spirit; no overlap found for the values themselves
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-30.
